result.question: Which benchmark dataset and its variants were used to evaluate KG2RAG? Answer only from the paper and give source quotes.
result.answer:
KG2RAG 在广泛使用的 HotpotQA 数据集及其新构建的变体上进行了实验评估。 [1]

其中一个变体为 Shuffle-HotpotQA，在 distractor 设置下报告了结果。 [2]

paragraphs.text: KG2RAG 在广泛使用的 HotpotQA 数据集及其新构建的变体上进行了实验评估。
其中一个变体为 Shuffle-HotpotQA，在 distractor 设置下报告了结果。

citations.quote: We conduct a series of experiments on the widely-used HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018) dataset and its newly constructed variants
experimental results on the HotpotQA and Shuffle-HotpotQA datasets in the distractor setting are shown in Ta- bles 3 and 4

insufficient: 片段未说明 HotpotQA 变体的完整清单或各变体的具体名称；除 Shuffle-HotpotQA 外，其余变体名称缺少证据。
